quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the room where visitors check in first!
quests.question: Office
quests.hint: Visitors usually stop here first when they arrive at school.
quests.explanation: Yes! The office is where visitors check in and school helpers do their work.
quests.funFact: The school office often keeps important papers safe for every single student!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the part of the day when we all eat!
quests.question: Lunchtime
quests.hint: This is the part of the day when every student stops to eat.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lunchtime is the part of the day when students stop to eat.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime often comes right in the middle of the school day, giving everyone energy!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the helper who takes care of us when we feel sick!
quests.question: School Nurse
quests.hint: This helper checks on you if you feel sick or get a small bump.
quests.explanation: Yes! A school nurse takes care of students who feel unwell or get hurt.
quests.funFact: A school nurse often keeps a cozy cot ready for students who need a short rest!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the person who drives the school bus safely!
quests.question: Bus Driver
quests.hint: This person sits at the front of the bus, holding the big wheel.
quests.explanation: Yes! A bus driver steers the school bus safely to and from school.
quests.funFact: A bus driver often learns the names of every student who rides their bus!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the big room where we run, jump, and play!
quests.question: Gym
quests.hint: This big indoor room has plenty of space for running and games.
quests.explanation: Yes! A gym is the room where we run, jump, and play active games.
quests.funFact: Many schools use their gym for both exercise class and special school events!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the practice work we finish at home!
quests.question: Homework
quests.hint: You usually do this after school, not during class time.
quests.explanation: Yes! Homework is the practice work students finish at home after school.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the lesson practice a teacher asks us to do at home!
quests.question: Homework
quests.hint: It gives you extra practice on something you learned that day.
quests.explanation: That's right! We complete homework at home to practice what we learned.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the happy time when we go outside to play!
quests.question: Recess
quests.hint: This is a short, happy break from lessons spent outside.
quests.explanation: Yes! Recess is the happy break when students go outside to play.
quests.funFact: Recess helps students feel refreshed and ready to learn again afterward!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the indoor room where we exercise and play games!
quests.question: Gym
quests.hint: You might play ball games or stretch here during class.
quests.explanation: That's right! We exercise and play games together inside the gym.
quests.funFact: Many schools use their gym for both exercise class and special school events!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the moment we open our lunchbox to eat!
quests.question: Lunchtime
quests.hint: You open your lunchbox or tray at exactly this time of day.
quests.explanation: That's right! We open our lunchbox and eat together at lunchtime.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime often comes right in the middle of the school day, giving everyone energy!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the room where the principal and helpers work!
quests.question: Office
quests.hint: This room often has a phone and helpers who greet everyone.
quests.explanation: That's right! We visit the office if we arrive late or need help.
quests.funFact: The school office often keeps important papers safe for every single student!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the person who checks a small cut or a tummy ache!
quests.question: School Nurse
quests.hint: This person often has bandages ready to help with a small scrape.
quests.explanation: That's right! We visit the school nurse for a bump, scrape, or tummy ache.
quests.funFact: A school nurse often keeps a cozy cot ready for students who need a short rest!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the time in the middle of the day set aside for food!
quests.question: Lunchtime
quests.hint: This is the part of the day when every student stops to eat.
quests.explanation: Well done! Lunchtime gives every student time to enjoy a meal and rest.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime often comes right in the middle of the school day, giving everyone energy!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the short break when students run and play games!
quests.question: Recess
quests.hint: You might swing, slide, or run with friends during this time.

quests.funFact: Recess helps students feel refreshed and ready to learn again afterward!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the helper who steers the bus to and from school!
quests.question: Bus Driver
quests.hint: This helper picks students up and drops them off safely each day.
quests.explanation: That's right! A bus driver makes sure every student gets home safely.

quests.question: Backpack
quests.hint: It has zippers and pockets to keep your school things safe inside.

quests.funFact: Backpacks have two straps so the weight spreads evenly across both shoulders!
